name: The Apolitain League
summary: A representative republic of god-championed city-states, balancing moderation in all things. Capital: Polita.

name: Lycia
summary: The former Pontinate Empire, now a pure democracy that killed its own gods twenty-five years ago. At total war with Sarmania over its northern colonies.

name: Sarmania
summary: A conquering theocratic empire ruled by Ereshkigal from the sky citadel Ganzir, a patchwork of feuding satraps. Capital: Ur-Nex.

name: Na-Keb
summary: The oldest continuous civilisation in the world, a vast river bureaucracy ruled by a god-chosen Pharaoh. Capital: Ari-Maat.

name: Maurkim
summary: A trade empire of great houses built on trust, competition and back-room deals. Capital: Maruk.
